projects.title: Blatnik Bridge replacement
projects.summary: The John A. Blatnik Bridge carries Interstate 535 over St. Louis Bay between Superior and Duluth. The Minnesota and Wisconsin transportation departments own it jointly and are replacing it on the same alignment. Minnesota leads the project.

facts.label: Federal grant
facts.note: Awarded in early 2024 under the federal infrastructure law.

facts.label: Each state's share
facts.note: Minnesota and Wisconsin split the rest equally.

timeline.text: The two states received the federal grant.
Lane changes, traffic signal work, and new pavement markings are planned on Belknap Street (U.S. 2) in Superior ahead of the closure. The contractor is Ames-Kraemer Joint Venture II.

Wisconsin is improving Winter Street and Susquehanna Avenue in Superior as alternate routes. Its part of the project also replaces the I-535 and Highway 35 interchange and rebuilds a segment of U.S. 53.
Full closure, so crews can remove the existing bridge.
Date by which the new bridge is scheduled to open.

data.note: Dates and costs are the agencies' published plans as of the date read, and can change.
